character: Traditional Vanoise valley village. Original Savoyard mountain farming village. Linked to La Plagne. Good for walkers. Beaufort cheese valley. Vanoise National Park access. Quiet, authentic.
dining: Local Savoyard restaurants, ferme-auberges (farm inns). Beaufort cheese production.
activities_nearby: Gondola to La Plagne/Paradiski. Vanoise National Park. Hiking, snowshoeing. Cheese farm visits.
